management_notes: The May 2026 data-compilation correction to Frost Cove results remains the primary management credibility overhang. The company disclosed promptly, but corrected intercepts (FC25-17: 2.00% Sb over 0.10m; FC25-27: 13.00% Sb over 0.57m) showed substantially narrower widths than originally reported — a meaningful QA/QC failure for a single-asset explorer whose investment case rests entirely on drill data. The original headline numbers (7.25% Sb over 1.98m and 6.44% Sb over 2.06m) were the basis of significant market attention and their correction has materially reduced credibility on early-stage data. Orderly execution of the Golden Baie option (TSXV-approved March 2026, Canstar share consideration issued) and launch of the 2026 two-rig program demonstrate operational competence. No new corporate governance or disclosure news found in the 2026-07-17 search. Score cannot recover to 3 until at least one full clean disclosure cycle follows the QA/QC incident — the pending 2026 assay releases from the northern extension are the first test.
geology_notes: The 2025 maiden drill program at Black Raven established high-grade antimony mineralisation at Frost Cove over approximately 800m strike — corrected standout intercepts include 7.25% Sb over 1.98m and 6.44% Sb over 2.06m near the Southern Shaft. The 2026 two-rig program completed 9 holes targeting the northern strike extension (~500m untested) with assays pending; the northern extension is the highest geological priority for both scope expansion and resource-estimate readiness. The Pomley Cove Pond gold-silver-molybdenum-lead-zinc vein swarm (20 veins within 150m width, channel-sampling confirmed) has been the subject of a press release titled 'Churchill Reports More High-Grade Gold and Silver Vein Results Near Past Producing Frost Cove Antimony Mine Including 17.3 g/t Au and 130 g/t Ag' — confirmed live on company IR and indexed by Junior Mining Network as of 2026-07-17, though full content remains inaccessible to this agent. No NI 43-101-compliant resource estimate exists for Black Raven or Golden Baie, which hard-caps the geology score at 3 regardless of intercept quality. Score advances to 4 upon filing of a compliant resource.
capital_notes: 316.7M shares issued and 342.8M fully diluted (per April 2026 interim MD&A extraction) is a heavy share structure for an early-stage explorer with no NI 43-101 resource. The 15.8M shares issued to Canstar as Golden Baie option consideration are included in the current outstanding count. Options total 23.45M (~7.4% dilution above issued); warrants are modest at 2.625M with no strike/expiry detail available from the April 2026 MD&A extraction. No flow-through tranches were detected in the April 2026 MD&A extraction data. Flow-through financing is structurally common for NL-domiciled explorers given the Newfoundland and Labrador Mineral Exploration Tax Credit, and any 2026 equity raise funding the two-rig program would likely carry a 4-month hold-release overhang on FT tranches — investors should watch for any 2026 placement announcements. Two active exploration programs (Black Raven + Golden Baie) sustain ongoing dilution pressure.

analyst_summary: Churchill Resources (TSXV: CRI) remains one of the few primary antimony explorers on Canadian exchanges at a moment when antimony is designated critical in both Canada and the US. Its consolidated Newfoundland footprint — Black Raven (host to the Frost Cove antimony zone) plus the optioned Golden Baie property (39,925 ha, 29 licences, central NL) — covers a district with proven historical production at Beaver Brook and high-grade corrected drill intercepts at Frost Cove (7.25% Sb over 1.98m; 6.44% Sb over 2.06m, post-QA/QC correction). As of 2026-07-17, a web search confirms the Pomley Cove Pond vein press release ('Churchill Reports More High-Grade Gold and Silver Vein Results… 17.3 g/t Au and 130 g/t Ag') is indexed on the company IR site and Junior Mining Network — content remains 403-blocked to this agent. The 9-hole 2026 Frost Cove northern extension (~500m untested strike) assays are still pending and represent the highest-impact near-term catalyst. No new material news beyond the above was found in today's search. Factor scores unchanged from 2026-07-16: management 2 (QA/QC correction overhang pending a clean follow-on disclosure cycle), geology 3 (no NI 43-101 resource caps the score regardless of intercept quality), capital 2 (316.7M issued / 342.8M fully diluted is heavy for a no-resource stage explorer), catalyst 4 (Pomley Cove vein results out, northern extension assays imminent), acquisition 2 (no NAV anchor). WATCH maintained. A move to BUY requires a clean NI 43-101 resource filing plus a demonstrated clean disclosure record post-May 2026 correction. Confidence low pending full assay content access and resource filing.
